desc:
👋 Welcome to Troll Obby!

If you think this is just a normal obby... you're already getting trolled. 😂 Every stage is filled with tricky surprises, hidden traps, and unexpected twists that will keep you guessing. Nothing is ever quite what it seems!

🧠 Think outside the box, question everything, and don't trust the obvious path if you want to make it to the end.

⭐ Like 👍 and Favorite ❤️ the game if you enjoyed it! More stages and updates are on the way.

🎯 100+ Stages
